mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.moim_account_id, k.account_number, k.bank_name, k.balance, m.account_name, owner_user.name AS owner_name, m.synced_at, CASE WHEN m.user_id = #{userId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS owner FROM moim_accounts m INNER JOIN kb_accounts k ON m.kb_account_id = k.kb_account_id INNER JOIN users owner_user ON owner_user.user_id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN `groups` g ON g.moim_account_id = m.moim_account_id LEFT JOIN group_users gu ON gu.group_id = g.group_id AND gu.user_id = #{userId} AND gu.group_user_status IN ( 'ACTIVE', 'PENDING_DEPOSIT' ) WHERE m.account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( m.user_id = #{userId} OR g.user_id = #{userId} OR gu.user_id IS NOT NULL )
SELECT m.moim_account_id, m.user_id, m.kb_account_id, m.account_status, m.account_name, m.created_at, m.synced_at, m.updated_at FROM moim_accounts m WHERE m.moim_account_id = #{moimAccountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO moim_accounts ( moim_account_id, user_id, kb_account_id, account_status, account_name ) VALUES ( #{moimAccountId}, #{userId}, #{kbAccountId}, #{accountStatus}, #{accountName} )
mapper.select: SELECT moim_account_id, user_id, kb_account_id, account_status, account_name, created_at, synced_at, updated_at FROM moim_accounts WHERE kb_account_id = #{kbAccountId} LIMIT 1

SELECT m.moim_account_id, k.balance, m.synced_at FROM moim_accounts m INNER JOIN kb_accounts k ON m.kb_account_id = k.kb_account_id WHERE m.moim_account_id = #{moimAccountId} AND m.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT k.kb_account_id, k.account_number, k.bank_name, k.balance, k.interest_rate, k.account_type FROM kb_accounts k LEFT JOIN moim_accounts m ON k.kb_account_id = m.kb_account_id WHERE k.name = #{name} AND k.birthday = #{birthday} AND k.account_type = 'MOIM' AND ( m.kb_account_id IS NULL OR m.account_status = 'DEACTIVATED' )
